review:
An 80s retro-gaming ways slot built on Flash Frames. Winning spots get framed and stay, the symbols inside reveal new ones, and further wins add more frames until nothing new wins.

A Swap scatter landing with Flash Frames reveals one paying symbol and turns every frame into it, which can create one big combined win. Three FS trigger the Retro Reboot bonus with 10 free spins. Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP, volatility or max win outside the game – check the info screen.
